BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

3. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

4. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

6. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.

7. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.

8. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.

9. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.

10. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

11. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.

12. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Building Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Wall Finishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Floor Finishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. B — CPU

3. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

5. B — Information and Communication Technology

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Building Drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Computer Aided Drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Wall Finishes; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Floor Finishes; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
